spec.title: Stored signal summary
spec.purpose: Compute descriptive statistics from selected stored signals without generating new signals.

acceptanceChecks.description: Contract and local entrypoint are valid.
Two distinct single-case fixtures retain their case identities and complete.
A batch produces the same per-case content as the two individual requests.
Execution does not mutate the supplied request or referenced artifacts.
Every artifact matches an output port and exact input IDs.
Selected fixture outputs match explicit expected content.
